inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pad dimensions do not match Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for specified service type (single-phase or three-phase)
inputs.question: On the electrical plan or detail sheets, are the specific dimensions of each transformer pad shown (length x width)? Is the service type (single-phase or three-phase) specified? Are cross-reference callouts to AE Design-approved pad detail sheets shown?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking about presence and labeling of dimensions, service-type designation, and cross-reference callouts—all label/notation readout and document-reference checks—rather than measuring or comparing actual pad dimensions against a standard. This is a progressive verification step (feature identification and annotation presence) before any dimensional compliance comparison would occur.
